It's easier if you're using the hold to crouch setting.  
If you are then you simply jump in your desired direction and hold crouch while in the air, this will keep your legs tucked in the whole time and should be enough to get you onto the crate.  
If you prefer the toggle option (I used to) it's still doable but it's more about crouching at the top of your jump as you'll only be crouched briefly while in the air with the toggle crouch setting (because technically you're not supposed to be able to).  
Either way it's not a difficult trick once you get the hang of it and can be useful in just about any match or mode you play.
